title: Effective Date of Tier Privileges on Northgate Memberships
content:
The everyday privileges of a tier of Northgate Memberships — early shopping before regular club hours, the guest allowance per visit (a guest may not make purchases), and the discount off the posted Northgate Fuel Center price — apply to every active card on the membership from the day the tier is recorded on the membership, and are never applied retroactively to earlier visits or fuel purchases.

A downgrade removes the Plus privileges from the day it is recorded. Annual Reward already accrued stays on the membership and is issued at the year end under the certificate terms.

## Reading the rule

| Event | Privileges from | Earlier visits and fuel purchases |
|---|---|---|
| Tier recorded at enrollment | the day recorded | — |
| Upgrade recorded | the day recorded, on every active card | not adjusted |
| Downgrade recorded | Plus privileges end the day recorded | not adjusted; accrued Annual Reward stays and is issued at year end |

## Hypothetical cases

- A Club member upgraded to Club Plus on 12 May bought fuel on 11 May: the Club Plus fuel discount does not apply to the 11 May purchase; it applies from 12 May.
- A Club Plus membership moved to Club on 3 August: early shopping and the fuel discount of the Plus tier stop on 3 August; Annual Reward accrued before then remains and is issued at the end of the year.
- A guest brought by a cardholder may enter within the tier's guest allowance but may not make purchases.
